modulation_entries.hypothesis: Diphenhydramine was hypothesized to reduce metoclopramide-induced akathisia by blocking histamine H1 and muscarinic receptors, thereby attenuating extrapyramidal side effects of dopamine D2 antagonism.
modulation_entries.citation: Akathisia occurred in 9 participants in metoclopramide 20mg+diphenhydramine arm vs 12 in metoclopramide 20mg+placebo arm
